newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: OFFICIAL LIST SHARES SAG, STABILITY EXPECTED.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL LIST SHARES SAG, STABILITY EXPECTED.

text.p: * Official list drops 17.68 points to 884.41 points.
* Group A shares inch up a 0.48 point to 1871.71 points.
* Central market turns over 411,026 litas from 319,176 litas.
* Brokers said share prices would stay stable in coming weeks.
The official list at Lithuania's stock exchange fell 17.68 points to 884.41 points, and brokers predicted stability in share prices as the summer doldrums settled over the listless bourse.
"It's quite silent," said one broker. "We can feel that it's summer."
"I think the indices will stay the same in the next couple of weeks, with maybe some small growth," the broker added.
Group A shares inched up 0.48 points to 1871.71 points, and the central market turned over 411,026 litas.

Hermis Bank, which together with rival Vilniaus bank inspired the bourse last week, remained in steady but active trading at an unchanged 190 litas and turning over 120,650 litas on the central market.
Hermis, which has become one of the darlings of the otherwise sleepy stock exchange, saw 182,870 litas worth of block trades between 185 litas and 190 litas.
Rival Vilniaus Bank dropped to 220.10 litas from 230 litas amid a tiny central market turnover of 2,201 litas.
Brokers say the weak market and anxiety over approaching six-month results are punishing shares.
Rokishkis Cheese, another of the sweathearts of the stock exchange, slipped to 40.50 litas from 42.00 litas amid central market turnover of 23,125 litas.
Fridge maker Snaige dropped to 12.30 litas from from 13.50 litas.
Market heavy weight Lithuanian Gas steadied the group A index, trading at an unchanged 1.60 litas.
